item.title: How Christians Grow in Discernment, A Biblical and Practical Guide
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains how biblical discernment is formed through the Word of God, prayer, testing all things by Scripture, walking with mature believers, and faithfully practicing obedience. True discernment is not suspicion or cynicism, but spiritual maturity shaped by God’s Word and strengthened through faithful obedience.

item.title: Evidence for a Young Universe
item.description: In this episode of Sound Theology & Discernment, Justin Peters interviews Dr. Jason Lisle of the Biblical Science Institute about scientific evidence that challenges the billions-of-years narrative and supports a young universe consistent with Scripture. Topics include planetary heat, magnetic fields, spiral galaxies, blue stars, comets, lunar recession, and insights from the James Webb Space Telescope when interpreted through a biblical worldview.

item.title: Job 3, When Words Fail, Lament in the Depths of Suffering
item.description: In Job 3, Job gives voice to profound grief without rejecting God. This reflection on lament shows how sorrow can be brought honestly before the Lord.
